# Curation notice

Upstream: Paul Bakaus, Impeccable (`pbakaus/impeccable`), commit `cf3d2fa07d3ad1814ac5fbbbb5b2043b795eaef1`, Apache-2.0. The complete Apache-2.0 license text and upstream copyright notice are included; upstream NOTICE.md is preserved byte-for-byte. LICENSE is a local standard-text copy, not claimed byte-identical to upstream. The platform-reference notice is retained for provenance completeness; the iOS and Android reference files themselves are not included.

LeeWay modified the existing `impeccable` binding into a locally available, selective design skill on 2026-10-06. The retained principles were rewritten and narrowed to the eight requested disciplines, project-context preservation, reusable design values and evidence separation. No upstream CLI, binary, runtime, hooks, updater, platform pack or detector implementation was copied. Upstream instructions to install or call services are not inherited.

The numeric measurement helper and its tests are original LeeWay code under MIT, not the upstream Impeccable detector. Its test outputs are not representations that the upstream detector ran. The HyperFrames profile is original integration guidance; it does not deploy or fork HyperFrames.

SOURCE.json identifies source references inspected and hashes computed from the retrieved source bytes. Those hashes identify inspected source; they do not demonstrate Formula execution or native editor qualification.
